shared_elements: carved stone surface in low relief
horizontal banding or division of the field
weathered grey-brown stone with schematic incised detail
suggestion of a human figure (schematic in A, explicit in B)
justification: Both are grey-brown stone surfaces worked in shallow relief and both include prominent circular disc forms set against a field divided by horizontal lines, which is about the limit of the correspondence. A is a free-standing, vertically oriented shaped block bearing a few isolated, heavily weathered schematic emblems, whereas B is a flat orthostat-like panel filled edge to edge with a crowded, naturalistic narrative of figures, animals and wheeled vehicles — utterly different in density, orientation and manner of carving.
